items.title: Gus Fontenet Interview
items.q: Wilbur plays, that's right, so on the clarinet.

ctx.x: How many sisters they want? They want letters and instruments, Jack. Letters and guitar. Letters and guitar. And Wilbur plays, that's right, so on the clarinet.
Frankie was a trombone player. George played piccolo. Piccolo? The musical family. Right.
